description: Build framework script for the MLT component, managing build, clean, configure, rebuild, and install actions for the sys_resource module within a larger project.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help information for script usage.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Performs the build process, including compiling the main module and ledCtrl if present.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Sets clean flag and invokes build.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Copies built libraries and binaries to target directories and creates symbolic links.
